brief:
Israeli tanks crossed the "yellow line" boundary into Hamas-controlled central Gaza on Wednesday, The Guardian reported, marking the military's first ground operation across the demarcation line since the ceasefire deal took effect. The incursion came as former military chief Gadi Eisenkot sought to form a government without Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The yellow line had served as a de facto boundary during the conflict. The timing of the crossing coincided with political negotiations over Israel's governing coalition.

title: Israeli tanks cross into central Gaza for first time since ceasefire
